title: Cupcake
bio: Cupcake is a self-taught artist who is currently in art school. Cupcake loves to draw realistic animals, landscapes, and, of course, with some dramatic lighting. Aside from digital art, she loves using many other mediums, like acrylic paint, pastels, and colored pencils. If you want to support her on her journey with art or commission her, visit her Instagram. Her DMs are always open.
